market_view: Calm regime (VIX 15.7, falling) with yields near highs at 4.55% and renewed US-Iran tension; soft inflation data lifted stocks. Earnings season has started.

oil_gas.reasoning: WTI rose 8% in 5 days to 79.6 on Iran tension, but XOM only +2.4%. Driver move is already priced and headlines are about inventories only. Earnings in late July add variance; no named edge.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold -7% in 20 days with yields near highs and the dollar firm. NEM headlines (Cadia restart, analyst notes) are minor and not a concrete catalyst.

chips.reasoning: TSMC profit +77% and a $100B Arizona investment are positive but already public and priced; NVDA headlines (Japan AI) are not new. Sector -8.7% in 20 days is not a rule I trust.

pharma.reasoning: No LLY-specific news; headlines are generic policy and law-firm items. Q2 earnings approach, which add variance only.

copper_uranium.reasoning: FCX -13% in 20 days, copper mixed, uranium ETF weak. The only headline is Cameco resolving a Cigar Lake disruption, which does not bear on FCX.

would_change_my_mind: A named, unpriced catalyst for a leader (for example an earnings surprise or guidance for NVDA, XOM, NEM, LLY or FCX) or a stress spike with a clear reversal reason.

handoff.what_changed: WTI rose to 79.6 (+8% in 5 days) amid US-Iran tension and yields rose again, while soft US inflation helped stocks. TSMC reported Q2 profit +77% and pledged another $100B in Arizona. VIX fell to 15.7. All families stay flat.

oil_gas.why: Crude jumped on Iran headlines but XOM lags and no durable edge is visible.

gold_miners.why: Gold is in a downtrend with high yields; NEM news is minor.

chips.why: TSMC results and investment are public and priced; no NVDA-specific catalyst.

pharma.why: No LLY news; earnings season adds variance only.

copper_uranium.why: Copper is mixed and the Cameco news does not help FCX.
